records.context: The null repeats the gene's own sampling, which is Funk et al.'s construction: for each of the gene's guides, as many non-targeting cells as that guide has are drawn and their median taken; the gene statistic is the median of those guide medians. A gene with two thin guides is therefore compared with what two thin non-targeting guides do, not with a null that assumes thousands of cells.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.bootstrap_gene_pvalues#8
records.source: THE NULL REPEATS THE GENE'S OWN SAMPLING, which is Funk et al.'s construction: for each of the gene's guides, as many non-targeting cells as that guide has are drawn and their median taken; the gene statistic is the median of those guide medians. A gene with two thin guides is therefore compared with what two thin non-targeting guides do, not with a null that assumes thousands of cells.
records.translation: 零分布重复该基因自身的抽样过程,这是 Funk et al. 的构建方式:对该基因的每个向导,抽取与该向导细胞数相同的非靶向细胞并取其中位数;基因统计量为这些向导中位数的中位数。因此,只有两个细胞数很少的向导的基因,是与两个细胞数同样很少的非靶向向导的表现相比较,而不是与假定有数千个细胞的零分布相比较。

records.context: A mitotic nucleus is condensed chromatin: its DNA is packed into a smaller area, so its MEAN DNA intensity is far above an interphase nucleus's while its area is at or below the median. Both are robust z scores against every cell of the group, so the rule needs no absolute intensity and travels between plates. It is a deliberately simple rule: Funk et al. 2022 trained a machine-learning classification model on DNA and tubulin features, which this does not reproduce, and a cell in early prophase or in telophase is missed.
records.label: spacr.gene_measurement_compare.mitotic_calls#8
records.source: A mitotic nucleus is condensed chromatin: its DNA is packed into a smaller area, so its MEAN DNA intensity is far above an interphase nucleus's while its area is at or below the median. Both are robust z scores against every cell of the group, so the rule needs no absolute intensity and travels between plates. It is a deliberately simple rule: Funk et al. 2022 trained a classifier on DNA and tubulin features, which this does not reproduce, and a cell in early prophase or in telophase is missed.
records.translation: 有丝分裂的细胞核是浓缩的染色质:其 DNA 被压缩到较小的面积内,因此其平均 DNA 强度远高于间期细胞核,而其面积处于或低于中位数。两者都是相对于该组所有细胞的稳健 z 分数,因此该规则不需要绝对强度,可以在不同板之间通用。这是一个刻意简化的规则:Funk et al. 2022 基于 DNA 和微管蛋白特征训练了分类器,而这里并未复现该分类器,处于前期早期或末期的细胞会被漏掉。

records.context: The controls set the scale, as in Funk et al. 2022: each well's non-targeting cells are that well's reference, so a well-to-well shift in staining moves the reference with it rather than reading as a phenotype. A group whose controls have zero spread, or no controls at all, is NaN rather than infinite.

records.source: THE CONTROLS SET THE SCALE, as in Funk et al. 2022: each well's non-targeting cells are that well's reference, so a well-to-well shift in staining moves the reference with it rather than reading as a phenotype. A group whose controls have zero spread, or no controls at all, is NaN rather than infinite.
records.translation: 由对照设定尺度,与 Funk et al. 2022 一致:每个孔的非靶向细胞即该孔的参照,因此孔与孔之间染色的偏移会使参照随之移动,而不会被误判为表型。对照没有离散度或完全没有对照的分组结果为 NaN,而不是无穷大。

records.context: Two independent segmentations of one field disagree at the edges: a nucleus straddles two cells, a cell holds two nuclei, a nucleus has no cell at all. spaCR's measurement joins a nucleus to one parent cell and refuses a field where that is ambiguous, so the ambiguity is resolved here: each nucleus goes to the cell it overlaps most and is clipped to that cell; a cell keeps its largest such nucleus; cells without a nucleus and nuclei without a cell are dropped and counted.

records.source: Two independent segmentations of one field disagree at the edges: a nucleus straddles two cells, a cell holds two nuclei, a nucleus has no cell at all. spaCR's measurement joins a nucleus to one parent cell and refuses a field where that is ambiguous, so the ambiguity is resolved here: each nucleus goes to the cell it overlaps most and is clipped to that cell; a cell keeps its largest such nucleus; cells without a nucleus and nuclei without a cell are dropped and counted.
records.translation: 同一视野的两次独立分割在边缘处并不一致:细胞核跨越两个细胞、一个细胞含有两个细胞核、某个细胞核没有对应的细胞。spaCR 的测量将一个细胞核连接到一个母细胞,并拒绝处理存在歧义的视野,因此歧义在此处解决:每个细胞核归入与其重叠最多的细胞,并被裁剪到该细胞内;每个细胞保留其中最大的此类细胞核;没有细胞核的细胞和没有细胞的细胞核被丢弃并计数。
